**Secure access to the Inflow resources via OIDC**  
![](data:image/png;base64,)  
- Any provider working under the OpenID Connect protocol acts as an Identity provider.  
- The Inflow application provides cookie authentication based on the issued Identity Provider tokens.  
- This works the same way for both SSR (Blazor web server) and the Blazor WASM client app and the MAUI hybrid mode mobile app via BlazorWebView.  
- All types of the Inflow application use the Authorization code flow.  
- Authorization code flow for SSR (Blazor web server) uses PKCE and Client secret.  
- Another Inflow app types uses authorization code flow only with PKCE because it’s a public client.  
- Third-party apps (integrations, for example) must use token of Identity provider for access to Inflow API.
